│ Review point 4: the client logs every request at INFO, even when nothing changes. How should
│ the libraries log? Java, Go and Python would all change before the next release.

❯ 1. INFO only for changes (Recommended)
     changed=true stays at INFO; changed=false and its reason go to DEBUG. Nothing new at INFO while nothing
     changes. The cost: unchanged requests only show with DEBUG on.
  2. Keep INFO for every request
     No change. Every request, changed or not, writes one INFO line in every service.
  3. Type something.
